reviews.author: Doug Green
reviews.text: This knowledgeable gentleman moved with precision and helped me accomplish my goals. He is welcome to my assistance anytime it's my turn next. Because he helped me it's the way more people should be.. Thank you

reviews.author: Alexandra Farrell
reviews.text: I would rate 6 stars if I could. We're from Canada, just passing through, when a rattle popped up in the car. Glen took us right away, fixed the problem within 30 minutes, and sent us on our way after a good conversation. Bless you Glen, you were such a big help, right from the start on the phone.

reviews.author: Joe Torbett
reviews.text: Glenn is THE MAN!!! We rolled up with some minor car troubles, had a great conversation with the man and were out of there with our car fix in about 30 minutes! Don't expect this, but the man didn't even charge us. A true gem!
